headline: Nvidia reportedly halts AI chip shipments to Southeast Asia
summary: Nvidia has reportedly halted AI chip shipments to data centers in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, and Indonesia, tied to U.S. efforts to keep AI chips out of China, in the same week it reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO. Outlets differ on whether the halt stems from a new export-license requirement or Nvidia's own directive to partners.
